officialText:
Section 700.10 – Revise Section 700.10(A)(2) to read as follows:

(2)An acceptable means of marking shall include, but is not limited to, a permanently affixed identification nameplate, yellow in color with black lettering. Accessible cable or raceway systems shall be marked at intervals not to exceed 10 ft (3 m) or identified by a continuous yellow outer finish along raceways entire length.
